_meta.note: G7 Counter-Nanite facility, stealth strike dropship, dropship cargo bays, base secure state. Every number is PROVISIONAL (master scope 6.2, 6.9, 9; brainstorm B2, B4, B9, B11, B18).

cn_checkpoint.name: Armoured Gate Checkpoint
cn_checkpoint._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-8): hardened pedestrian gatehouse in the wall line: two-door mantrap (team gates at _g7_facility.mantrap, owner only, sealed on lockdown), ID / scan station (mimics exposed), guard bunker with firing ports (garrisonable, remote weapon station). PROVISIONAL.

a_g7_camera.name: Security Camera
a_g7_camera._note: BASE7 (13.9b): a pan-tilt camera mast that watches its sector (real sight for the base, no weapon). PROVISIONAL.

a_g7_vtol_pad.name: Dropship Landing Pad
a_g7_vtol_pad._note: BASE7-2 (13.9c): 24 m landing site for the 19.6 x 16.7 m VTOL / stealth dropships (Last Protocol airfield). Flat: units walk and drive onto it (rear-ramp loading). Entity field facing_i = the side of its 3-tile approach lane (0 +x, 1 +y, 2 -x, 3 -y). Art: ART7F. PROVISIONAL.

cn_link_wall.name: Wash Link Wall
cn_link_wall._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-9): 1-tile hardened T-wall run joining the outer gate layer to the inner gate layer on both sides of the APC wash (enclosed wash). Drawn as one g7_fac_linkwall zone sprite per run (entity_layer skips the cells). PROVISIONAL.

cn_magazine.name: Special Ammunition Magazine
cn_magazine._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-6): the armoured cell of the earth-covered magazine (zone magazine, art g7_fac_magazine). The teams' special ammo resupply point (CnFacility services) and a priority target: destroyed, it cooks off (services.cookoff) and resupply stops. PROVISIONAL.

_g7_bay_seq._note: CNFAC7-2 C-17-style rear-ramp loading (scope 6.9, art.dropship_sizes rev4 geometry, tiles along the nose axis). PROVISIONAL timings.

_g7_facility._layout_note: BASE7-3 (13.9c-2/-3, PROVISIONAL): two-layer APC entry on the south wall: gate_outer (reinforced gate in the wall) -> apc_wash (APC decon wash between the layers) -> gate_inner -> staging yard; the infantry come in through the checkpoint (wall slot x18, a wall section x16 apart from the vehicle gate) up their own walkway (x17..20, y24..25) into the decon hall (x17..20, y21..23) and out north onto the y20 lane. Every building keeps its own footprint with >= 1 tile clearance to every other building (garages stand in two rows), doors open onto lanes, lanes never cross a footprint. Garage rows W/E on lanes x6..7 / x20..21; loading pad (stealth launch pad) + helipad on the north wall with the apron x15..18; planning room and package lab on the spine (x12..15); drone bay under the helipad apron; training range SW, workshop SE. Wall ring: 2x2 blast walls on even offsets, 16 hardened towers ON the wall line (13.9c-3 + 13.9c-4: 4 corners, 2-3 per long run, both entry flanks), closed and tied in on both sides; every tower keeps a free inner cell (wall-walk stairs, 13.9c-4) and no building lines a whole wall run. 13.9c-4 sentries: 1x1 a_t7_hmg_nest posts on the inner face of every wall run of >= 2 segments (they fire over the wall), facing outward, never on a tower's last free access cell, a door or a footprint. Core moved to [3,3] so the NW corner has its stair cell; range 8x4 / workshop 4x4 leave the south inner face open. 'gate' / 'decon' are code aliases of gate_outer / apc_wash (not drawn).
_g7_facility._fac6_note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-6, PROVISIONAL): magazine = hardened earth-covered igloo (2x4 = 8x16 m) in the SE corner, farthest from the core / ops room, door north onto the y20 lane behind a traverse; its 2x2 armoured cell (magazine_part) is a real sim building (the priority target; cooks off when destroyed). armory = armory + suit bay on the infantry path (decon hall north door -> armory south door -> west door into the staging yard). aid_station (+ quarantine bay) is attached to the decon hall's east wall (one building, listed in 'attached'). barracks = the Sentinel barracks (owner 13.9c-10, was the 13.9c-6 ready room; trains / houses the facility guard company, backup generator on its roof slab) in the NE corner by the helipad. fuel_point = flush hot-refuel / rearm pits on the helipad apron (a marking on the apron lane, no footprint); the garages rearm too. runoff = contaminated-runoff tank beside the APC wash (equipment, no building). The workshop moved into the old drone-bay slot (APC repair on the spine), the drone bay shrank to 4x2 below it, the staging yard to 8x3, the helipad one tile west (ready room room). 13.9c-8: gate_inner turned to the outer gate's axis (faces); mantrap = the foot entry control point's two door cells (outer, inner) in the checkpoint gatehouse: team gates open only for the owner, both sealed on lockdown.

helipad_craft.note: art.dropship_sizes rev3/rev4: 6x6 pad, craft pivot on the pad centre, nose +u (east), rear ramp west onto the apron lane x15..18 (open ground to u -5.8 for the APC line-up)
